description: This file defines a controller class for handling the settings and interface for the 'Cash on Delivery' (COD) payment method in an OpenCart administrative panel. It manages rendering the configuration page, loading necessary data such as order statuses and geo zones, and saving configuration changes.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class for managing the COD payment method settings in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the COD payment method configuration page, loading necessary data such as order statuses and geo zones.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the COD payment method after user submits the form.
